brand.name: CloudPay
brand.theme: Dark Mode Default with High-Contrast Fintech Aesthetics

rules: Containers with borders MUST have internal padding p-5 or p-[1.5rem] to prevent text collisions
Financial tables and transaction ledgers must use explicit cell padding (py-3 px-4)
All numeric metrics, currency totals, transaction hashes, and API IDs must render in monospaced font (JetBrains Mono)
Grid children must be direct children; motion wrappers must carry grid span classes if animated

visual_enhancers.surface_style: 1px sharp border stroke with subtle inner glow + dark matte panels
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-md bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-800/80 for floating headers and sticky topbars
visual_enhancers.charts: Shadcn Chart / Recharts with semi-transparent area gradients (e.g., blue to transparent) and crisp zero-line borders
visual_enhancers.badges: Pill badges with low-opacity colored backgrounds and high-contrast text (e.g. bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20)

modules_covered: Payment Engine & Provider/Plugin Adapters Config (Stripe, Adyen, PayPal, Crypto)
Risk, Fraud Score, KYC/AML Verification Engine
FX Engine & Digital Asset / VDA Boundary Control

accessibility_and_testing.contrast_standard: WCAG AA / APCA compliant (min 4.5:1 text contrast)
accessibility_and_testing.keyboard_navigation: Explicit visible focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:outline-none)

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the layout feels like a command center: dense, sleek, clean grid panels with subtle slate borders.
Use Lucide icons (lucide-react) or @phosphor-icons/react for clear visual telemetry.
Include data-testid on every interactive button, input, tab, select, table row, and metric card.
Do NOT use Space Grotesk font. Stick to Outfit for headers, Inter for text, and JetBrains Mono for monetary values/IDs.
Ensure all form interactions use customized Shadcn primitives (Input, Select, Dialog, Sheet, Tabs, Switch, Table, Badge).
Use Sonner toasts for real-time notifications (payment triggered, key rotated, settlement generated).
